from .blocks import Document, parse_blocks
from .inlines import parse_inlines


def render(markdown: str) -> str:
    """Render a complete Markdown document to HTML.

    This foundation exposes the integration point; parsing and rendering behavior
    are supplied by later parser capabilities.
    """
    document = parse_blocks(markdown)
    for block in document.children:
        if block.kind in {"paragraph", "heading"}:
            parse_inlines(block.literal, document.references)
    return ""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import re


@dataclass
class InlineNode:
    type: str
    literal: str = ""
    destination: str = ""
    label: str = ""


_URI = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]{1,31}:[^ <>\x00-\x20<>]*\Z")
_EMAIL = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)*\Z")


def parse_autolinks(source: str) -> list[InlineNode]:
    """Split valid angle-delimited autolinks from ordinary text."""
    nodes: list[InlineNode] = []
    pos = 0
    for match in re.finditer(r"<([^<>\n]*)>", source):
        body = match.group(1)
        destination = body if _URI.fullmatch(body) else "mailto:" + body if _EMAIL.fullmatch(body) else ""
        if not destination:
            continue
        if match.start() > pos:
            nodes.append(InlineNode("text", source[pos:match.start()]))
        nodes.append(InlineNode("link", destination=destination, label=body))
        pos = match.end()
    if pos < len(source):
        nodes.append(InlineNode("text", source[pos:]))
    return nodes

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import re
from .fenced_code import parse_fenced_code
from .html_blocks import parse_html_block
from .indented_code import parse_indented_code
from .references import extract_definitions
from .setext import parse_setext


@dataclass
class Block:
    """A minimal block node retaining source for later inline parsing."""

    kind: str
    children: list["Block"] = field(default_factory=list)
    literal: str = ""
    level: int | None = None
    info: str = ""
    ordered: bool = False
    start: int = 1
    tight: bool = True

    @property
    def type(self) -> str:
        """Compatibility name for the block node's kind."""
        return self.kind


@dataclass
class Document:
    """Ordered block tree and document-wide reference definitions."""

    children: list[Block] = field(default_factory=list)
    references: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)


def _thematic(line: str) -> bool:
    match = re.fullmatch(r" {0,3}([*_\-])(?:[ \t]*\1){2,}[ \t]*", line)
    return bool(match)


def _atx(line: str):
    match = re.match(r"^ {0,3}(#{1,6})(?:[ \t]+(.*)|[ \t]*$)", line)
    if not match:
        return None
    content = (match.group(2) or "").strip(" \t")
    content = re.sub(r"[ \t]+#+[ \t]*$", "", content).strip(" \t")
    return len(match.group(1)), content


def _quote_content(line: str) -> tuple[str, bool] | None:
    """Return quote content and whether the marked line is blank."""
    indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
    if indent > 3 or indent >= len(line) or line[indent] != ">":
        return None
    content = line[indent + 1:]
    # A single following space or tab is part of the marker. Tabs are kept
    # intact so subsequent indentation is interpreted by normal block rules.
    if content.startswith(" "):
        content = content[1:]
    elif content.startswith("\t"):
        content = content[1:]
    return content, not content.strip(" \t")


_LIST_MARKER = re.compile(r"^( {0,3})([-+*]|([0-9]{1,9})([.)]))([ \t]+|$)(.*)$")


def _list_marker(line: str):
    match = _LIST_MARKER.match(line)
    if not match:
        return None
    indent, marker, digits, delimiter, whitespace, rest = match.groups()
    if marker in "-*+" and _thematic(line):
        return None
    if marker in "-*+" and re.fullmatch(r" {0,3}[ *_-](?:[ \t]*[ *_-]){2,}[ \t]*", line):
        # A thematic-break-shaped line with mixed marker characters is not
        # itself a thematic break, and should not become a list item either.
        return None
    ordered = digits is not None
    start = int(digits) if ordered else 1
    if ordered and start > 999999999:
        return None
    width = len(indent) + len(marker)
    pad = len(whitespace.expandtabs(4))
    if rest and pad > 4:
        rest = " " * (pad - 1) + rest
        pad = 1
    else:
        pad = max(1, pad)
    return (len(indent), marker if not ordered else delimiter, ordered, start, width + pad, rest, bool(rest.strip(" \t")))


def parse_blocks(markdown: str) -> Document:
    """Parse supported block structures, retaining inline source where needed."""
    document = Document()
    paragraph: list[str] = []

    def finish_paragraph() -> None:
        if not paragraph:
            return
        # Continuation indentation is structural, while trailing whitespace on
        # those lines remains available to the inline parser (for hard breaks).
        lines = [paragraph[0].lstrip(" \t")]
        lines.extend(line.lstrip(" \t") for line in paragraph[1:])
        literal = "\n".join(lines).rstrip(" \t")
        literal = extract_definitions(literal + "\n", document.references).rstrip("\n")
        if literal:
            document.children.append(Block(kind="paragraph", literal=literal))
        paragraph.clear()

    lines = markdown.splitlines()
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        quote_line = _quote_content(line)
        if quote_line:
            finish_paragraph()
            quote_lines: list[str] = []
            has_paragraph = False
            while i < len(lines):
                marked = _quote_content(lines[i])
                if marked:
                    content, blank = marked
                    quote_lines.append(content)
                    has_paragraph = bool(content.strip(" \t"))
                    i += 1
                    continue
                # Blank lines without a marker close the quote. Missing quote
                # markers are lazy only while a paragraph is open.
                if not lines[i].strip(" \t"):
                    break
                if not has_paragraph:
                    break
                if _thematic(lines[i]) or _atx(lines[i]) or parse_fenced_code(lines[i:]) or parse_html_block(lines[i:]):
                    break
                quote_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            child_doc = parse_blocks("\n".join(quote_lines))
            document.references.update(child_doc.references)
            document.children.append(Block(kind="block_quote", children=child_doc.children))
            continue
        if not line.strip(" \t"):
            finish_paragraph()
            i += 1
            continue
        marker = _list_marker(line)
        if marker:
            indent, marker_type, ordered, start, content_column, rest, nonempty = marker
            # Lists may interrupt paragraphs only with a nonempty item; ordered
            # lists that interrupt must begin at one.
            if paragraph and (not nonempty or (ordered and start != 1)):
                paragraph.append(line)
                i += 1
                continue
            finish_paragraph()
            items: list[Block] = []
            list_loose = False
            while i < len(lines):
                current = _list_marker(lines[i])
                if not current or current[0] != indent or current[1] != marker_type or current[2] != ordered:
                    break
                item_indent, _, _, _, item_column, item_rest, _ = current
                item_lines = [item_rest]
                i += 1
                saw_blank = False
                while i < len(lines):
                    nxt = _list_marker(lines[i])
                    if nxt and nxt[0] == indent:
                        break
                    if not lines[i].strip(" \t"):
                        saw_blank = True
                        item_lines.append("")
                        i += 1
                        continue
                    leading = len(lines[i]) - len(lines[i].lstrip(" "))
                    if leading >= item_column:
                        item_lines.append(lines[i][min(item_column, leading):])
                        i += 1
                        continue
                    if saw_blank:
                        break
                    # Lazy continuation is allowed only for an open paragraph.
                    if not item_lines or not item_lines[-1].strip(" \t"):
                        break
                    if _thematic(lines[i]) or _atx(lines[i]) or _list_marker(lines[i]) or parse_fenced_code(lines[i:]) or parse_html_block(lines[i:]):
                        break
                    item_lines.append(lines[i])
                    i += 1
                if saw_blank:
                    list_loose = True
                item_doc = parse_blocks("\n".join(item_lines).strip("\n"))
                document.references.update(item_doc.references)
                if any(child.kind == "paragraph" for child in item_doc.children) and (saw_blank or any(child.kind == "paragraph" for child in item_doc.children[1:])):
                    list_loose = True
                items.append(Block(kind="item", children=item_doc.children))
            document.children.append(Block(kind="list", children=items, ordered=ordered, start=start, tight=not list_loose))
            continue
        setext = parse_setext([*paragraph, line]) if paragraph else None
        if setext:
            level, literal = setext
            paragraph.clear()
            document.children.append(Block(kind="heading", level=level, literal=literal))
            i += 1
            continue
        fenced = parse_fenced_code(lines[i:])
        html = parse_html_block(lines[i:], paragraph_open=bool(paragraph))
        heading = _atx(line)
        if fenced:
            finish_paragraph()
            content, info, consumed = fenced
            document.children.append(Block(kind="fenced_code", literal=content, info=info))
            i += consumed
        elif _thematic(line):
            finish_paragraph()
            document.children.append(Block(kind="thematic_break"))
            i += 1
        elif heading:
            finish_paragraph()
            level, content = heading
            document.children.append(Block(kind="heading", level=level, literal=content))
            i += 1
        elif html:
            finish_paragraph()
            raw, consumed = html
            document.children.append(Block(kind="html_block", literal=raw))
            i += consumed
        else:
            code = parse_indented_code(lines[i:], paragraph_open=bool(paragraph))
            if code:
                finish_paragraph()
                content, consumed = code
                document.children.append(Block(kind="indented_code", literal=content))
                i += consumed
            else:
                paragraph.append(line)
                i += 1
    finish_paragraph()
    return document

"""Fenced code block recognition."""

import re

_OPEN = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$")


def parse_fenced_code(lines: list[str]):
    if not lines:
        return None
    match = _OPEN.match(lines[0])
    if not match:
        return None
    fence, info = match.groups()
    if fence[0] == "`" and "`" in info:
        return None
    info = info.strip(" \t")
    indent = len(lines[0]) - len(lines[0].lstrip(" "))
    close = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}" + re.escape(fence[0]) + r"{" + str(len(fence)) + r",}[ \t]*$")
    content = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines[1:], 1):
        if close.match(line):
            return "".join(line[max(indent, 0):] + "\n" for line in content), info, index + 1
        content.append(line)
    return "".join(line[indent:] + "\n" for line in content), info, len(lines)

"""CommonMark raw HTML block recognition."""

import re

_BLOCK = set("address article aside base basefont blockquote body caption center col colgroup dd details dialog dir div dl dt fieldset figcaption figure footer form frame frameset h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 head header hr html iframe legend li link main menu menuitem nav noframes ol optgroup option p param search section summary table tbody td tfoot th thead title tr track ul".split())


def _start(line: str):
    text = line[3:] if line.startswith("   ") else line
    if not line.startswith(" ") or len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" ")) <= 3:
        pass
    else:
        return None
    patterns = [
        (1, re.compile(r"<(?:pre|script|style|textarea)(?:[ \t/>]|$)", re.I), re.compile(r"</(?:pre|script|style|textarea)\s*>", re.I)),
        (2, re.compile(r"<!--"), re.compile(r"-->")),
        (3, re.compile(r"<\?"), re.compile(r"\?>")),
        (4, re.compile(r"<![A-Z]"), re.compile(r">")),
        (5, re.compile(r"<!\[CDATA\["), re.compile(r"\]\]>")),
    ]
    for kind, begin, end in patterns:
        if begin.match(text):
            return kind, end
    tag = re.match(r"</?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*)(?:[ \t]+[^<>]*[ \t]*)?/?>[ \t]*$", text)
    if tag and tag.group(1).lower() in _BLOCK:
        return 6, None
    if re.fullmatch(r"</?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*(?:[ \t]+[^<>]*)?/?>[ \t]*", text):
        return 7, None
    return None


def parse_html_block(lines: list[str], paragraph_open: bool = False):
    if not lines:
        return None
    start = _start(lines[0])
    if not start:
        return None
    kind, end = start
    if kind == 7 and paragraph_open:
        return None
    consumed = 0
    for line in lines:
        if kind >= 6 and not line.strip(" \t"):
            break
        consumed += 1
        if end and end.search(line):
            break
    return "".join(line + "\n" for line in lines[:consumed]), consumed

    nested = parse_images(source, references)

    # syntax; inline providers then decode escapes/entities and emphasis.

    while i < len(source):
        if source.startswith("![", i):
            close = _bracket_end(source, i + 1)
            if close is not None:
                label = source[i + 2:close]
                after = close + 1
                parsed = _destination_and_title(source, after + 1) if after < len(source) and source[after] == "(" else None
                dest = parsed is not None
                if parsed:
                    out.append(_plain_description(label, references)); i = parsed[2]; continue
                ref_label, end = label, after
                if after < len(source) and source[after] == "[":
                    ref_close = _bracket_end(source, after)
                    if ref_close is not None:
                        ref_label = source[after + 1:ref_close] or label
                        end = ref_close + 1
                if _normalize_label(_decode(ref_label)) in references:
                    out.append(_plain_description(label, references)); i = end; continue
        out.append(source[i]); i += 1
    plain = "".join(out)
    links = parse_links(plain, references)
    pieces: list[str] = []

        if node.type == "link":
            pieces.extend(_plain_nodes(node.children or []))
        else:

    return "".join(pieces)


def _plain_nodes(nodes: list) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    for node in nodes:
        if node.type in {"text", "code"}:
            result.append(node.literal)
        elif node.children:
            result.extend(_plain_nodes(node.children))

    """Parse image constructs in source, resolving definitions by normalized label."""
    nodes: list[ImageNode] = []
    i = 0

        if source[i] != "!" or (i and source[i - 1] == "\\") or i + 1 >= len(source) or source[i + 1] != "[":
            i += 1; continue
        close = _bracket_end(source, i + 1)
        if close is None:
            i += 1; continue
        label = source[i + 2:close]

        if parsed is not None:

        else:

                    ref_label = source[after + 1:ref_close] or label
                    end = ref_close + 1

"""Indented code block recognition."""


def _strip_columns(line: str, columns: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
    index = 0
    visual = 0
    while index < len(line) and visual < columns and line[index] in " \t":
        next_visual = visual + (4 - visual % 4 if line[index] == "\t" else 1)
        if next_visual > columns:
            return " " * (next_visual - columns) + line[index + 1 :], index + 1
        visual = next_visual
        index += 1
    return line[index:], index


def parse_indented_code(lines: list[str], paragraph_open: bool = False):
    leading = 0
    for char in lines[0] if lines else "":
        if char == " ":
            leading += 1
        elif char == "\t":
            leading += 4 - leading % 4
        else:
            break
    if paragraph_open or not lines or not lines[0].strip(" \t") or leading < 4:
        return None
    kept: list[str] = []
    consumed = 0
    pending_blanks = 0
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip(" \t"):
            pending_blanks += 1
            consumed += 1
            continue
        rest, removed = _strip_columns(line, 4)
        if removed == 0:
            break
        kept.extend([""] * pending_blanks)
        pending_blanks = 0
        kept.append(rest)
        consumed += 1
    consumed -= pending_blanks
    if not kept:
        return None
    return "".join(part + "\n" for part in kept), consumed

"""Recognition of inline HTML tokens and hard line breaks."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import re


@dataclass
class InlineNode:
    type: str
    literal: str = ""


_TAG = re.compile(r"</?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*(?:[ \t\n]+(?:[^<>\"']|'[^']*'|\"[^\"]*\")*)?[ \t]*/?>")
_COMMENT = re.compile(r"<!--(?:>|->|--!?>|(?:(?!-->|--!>).)*?(?:-->|--!>))", re.S)
_HTML = re.compile(r"<(?:[!?](?:[^<>]|'[^']*'|\"[^\"]*\")+|\[CDATA\[.*?\]\]|/?[A-Za-z][^<>]*)>", re.S)


def _html_at(source: str, start: int) -> int | None:
    comment = _COMMENT.match(source, start)
    if comment:
        return comment.end()
    match = _HTML.match(source, start)
    if not match:
        return None
    token = match.group()
    if token.startswith("<![CDATA[") or token.startswith("<!--") or token.startswith("<?") or token.startswith("<!"):
        return match.end()
    return match.end() if _TAG.fullmatch(token) else None


def parse_inline_html_breaks(source: str) -> list[InlineNode]:
    """Split raw HTML and CommonMark hard breaks from source text."""
    result: list[InlineNode] = []
    text: list[str] = []
    def flush() -> None:
        if text:
            result.append(InlineNode("text", "".join(text)))
            text.clear()
    i = 0
    while i < len(source):
        if source[i] == "<":
            end = _html_at(source, i)
            if end is not None:
                flush()
                result.append(InlineNode("html", source[i:end]))
                i = end
                continue
        if source[i] == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] in "\r\n":
            flush(); result.append(InlineNode("hardbreak")); i += 2
            if source[i - 1] == "\r" and i < len(source) and source[i] == "\n": i += 1
            continue
        if source[i] in "\r\n":
            end = i
            while end > 0 and source[end - 1] == " ": end -= 1
            if end < i and i - end >= 2:
                while text and text[-1] == " ": text.pop()
                flush(); result.append(InlineNode("hardbreak"))
            else:
                text.append("\n")
            i += 2 if source[i:i + 2] == "\r\n" else 1
            continue
        text.append(source[i]); i += 1
    flush()
    return result

        result.extend(chunks or [node])
    return result


def _punct(char: str) -> bool:
    return bool(char) and (char in _ASCII_PUNCTUATION or __import__("unicodedata").category(char).startswith("P"))

_ESCAPE = re.compile(r"\\([!\"#$%&'()*+,\-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])")
_ENTITY = re.compile(r"&(?:#[xX][0-9A-Fa-f]{1,6}|#[0-9]{1,7}|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+);")


def _decode(value: str) -> str:
    value = _ESCAPE.sub(r"\1", value)
    return _ENTITY.sub(lambda m: html.unescape(m.group()), value)


def _normalize_label(label: str) -> str:

def _destination_and_title(source: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, str | None, int] | None:
    """Parse the contents after an opening parenthesis; return end after ')' ."""
    i, n = start, len(source)
    while i < n and source[i] in " \t\n\r":
        i += 1
    destination = ""
    if i < n and source[i] == "<":
        i += 1
        part: list[str] = []
        while i < n:
            if source[i] == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                part.extend((source[i], source[i + 1])); i += 2; continue
            if source[i] == "<" or source[i] in "\r\n":
                return None
            if source[i] == ">":
                i += 1; destination = _decode("".join(part)); break
            part.append(source[i]); i += 1
        else:
            return None
    else:
        depth, part = 0, []
        while i < n:
            c = source[i]
            if c == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                part.extend((c, source[i + 1])); i += 2; continue
            if c in " \t\n\r":
                break
            if c == "(":
                depth += 1
                if depth > 32: return None
            elif c == ")":
                if depth == 0: break
                depth -= 1
            part.append(c); i += 1
        if depth:
            return None
        destination = _decode("".join(part))
    whitespace = i
    while i < n and source[i] in " \t\n\r":
        i += 1
    separated = i > whitespace
    title = None
    if i < n and source[i] in "\"'(":
        opener = source[i]; closer = ")" if opener == "(" else opener
        i += 1; part = []
        while i < n:
            c = source[i]
            if c == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                part.extend((c, source[i + 1])); i += 2; continue
            if c == closer:
                title = _decode("".join(part)); i += 1; break
            if c in "\r\n" and opener != "(":
                return None
            part.append(c); i += 1
        else:
            return None
        if not separated:  # title must be separated from destination
            return None
        while i < n and source[i] in " \t\n\r": i += 1
    if i >= n or source[i] != ")":
        return None
    return destination, title, i + 1


def _bracket_end(source: str, opening: int) -> int | None:
    depth, i = 1, opening + 1
    while i < len(source):
        if source[i] == "\\":
            i += 2; continue
        if source[i] == "[": depth += 1
        elif source[i] == "]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return i
        i += 1
    return None


def parse_links(source: str, references: dict) -> list[Inline | LinkNode]:
    """Parse links from inline source using an already collected reference map."""
    result: list[Inline | LinkNode] = []
    text: list[str] = []

    def flush() -> None:
        if text:
            result.append(Inline("text", "".join(text)))
            text.clear()

    i = 0
    while i < len(source):
        if source[i] == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source):
            text.extend(source[i:i + 2]); i += 2; continue
        if source[i] != "[" or (i and source[i - 1] == "!"):
            text.append(source[i]); i += 1; continue
        close = _bracket_end(source, i)
        if close is None:
            text.append(source[i]); i += 1; continue
        label_source = source[i + 1:close]
        parsed: tuple[str, str | None, int] | None = None
        after = close + 1
        if after < len(source) and source[after] == "(":
            parsed = _destination_and_title(source, after + 1)
        if parsed is not None:
            dest, title, end = parsed
        else:
            reference_label = label_source
            end = after
            if after < len(source) and source[after] == "[":
                ref_close = _bracket_end(source, after)
                if ref_close is not None:
                    reference_label = source[after + 1:ref_close] or label_source
                    end = ref_close + 1
            entry = references.get(_normalize_label(_decode(reference_label)))
            if entry is None:
                text.append(source[i]); i += 1; continue
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                dest, title = entry.get("destination", ""), entry.get("title")
            else:
                dest, title = entry[0], entry[1] if len(entry) > 1 else None
        flush()
        result.append(LinkNode("link", destination=dest, title=title,
                               children=parse_inlines(label_source, {})))
        i = end
    flush()
    return result

"""Document-wide link reference definition extraction."""

import html
import re

_LABEL = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}\[([^\[\]]+)\]:[ \t]*(.*)$")


def _unescape(value: str) -> str:
    value = html.unescape(value)
    return re.sub(r"\\([!\"#$%&'()*+,\-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])", r"\1", value)


def _label(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(value.casefold().strip(" \t\r\n").split())


def extract_definitions(text: str, references: dict) -> str:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offset = 0
    while offset < len(lines):
        current = lines[offset].rstrip("\r\n")
        match = _LABEL.match(current)
        if not match or not match.group(1).strip(" \t"):
            break
        key = _label(match.group(1))
        rest = match.group(2).strip(" \t")
        destination = None
        title = None
        if rest.startswith("<"):
            end = rest.find(">")
            if end > 0 and "\n" not in rest[1:end]:
                destination, tail = rest[1:end], rest[end + 1:].strip(" \t")
            else:
                break
        else:
            dest_match = re.match(r"((?:\\.|[^\s])*)", rest)
            destination = dest_match.group(1) if dest_match else ""
            tail = rest[len(destination):].strip(" \t")
            if destination.count("(") - destination.count(")") > 0:
                break
        if not destination:
            break
        if tail:
            if tail[0] not in "\"'(" or tail[-1] != ({'"': '"', "'": "'", "(": ")"}[tail[0]]):
                break
            title = _unescape(tail[1:-1])
        references.setdefault(key, (_unescape(destination), title))
        offset += 1
        if offset < len(lines) and lines[offset].lstrip(" \t").startswith(("\"", "'", "(")) and title is None:
            candidate = lines[offset].strip(" \t\r\n")
            if len(candidate) >= 2 and candidate[0] in "\"'(" and candidate[-1] == {'"': '"', "'": "'", "(": ")"}[candidate[0]]:
                references[key] = references.get(key, (_unescape(destination), _unescape(candidate[1:-1])))
                offset += 1
    return "".join(lines[offset:])

"""Setext heading recognition for paragraph source lines."""

import re
from collections.abc import Sequence

_UNDERLINE = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}(=+|-+)[ \t]*$")


def parse_setext(lines: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
    """Return a heading level and raw content for paragraph lines plus underline."""
    if len(lines) < 2:
        return None
    match = _UNDERLINE.fullmatch(lines[-1])
    if match is None:
        return None
    content = "\n".join(lines[:-1]).strip(" \t")
    if not content:
        return None
    return (1 if match.group(1)[0] == "=" else 2), content
